summary: Friday's close extended the same dollar and real-yield squeeze on gold, now down for a second straight week, while a narrow mega-cap tech rally kept stocks in greed territory despite weak breadth. Long-duration bonds kept sliding in tandem with gold, leaving crypto's steadier uptrend as the session's relative outlier.
tweet: Dollar strength and elevated real yields kept pressuring gold and long bonds Friday, while a narrow tech-led rally held stocks in greed territory.
